parameters.content:
## Post to QuickBooks
Posts ready invoices as **bills** (credit notes as **vendor credits**) with the original file attached.

The **core service decides** the content of each bill, what each QuickBooks answer means, and whether a failure is retried, stopped or sent to review. This workflow makes the calls and passes the answers through. Every write is reserved in the database first, searched before it is created and sent with a fixed request ID, so a retry never creates a second bill.

## Start and claim
Every 15 minutes, after each email intake, or by hand. QuickBooks' closing date is read first: the core posts nothing into a closed period. The core then hands out up to 10 invoices.

nodes.name: Note: One invoice at a time

parameters.content:
## One invoice at a time
Create the bill, or only attach the file if the bill already exists.

## Vendor
Use the linked vendor, or search by name: the core decides to use it, create it (one vendor per currency) or send the invoice to review.

## Exchange rate
Foreign-currency invoices only: QuickBooks' own rate for the invoice date.

## Bill or vendor credit
Searched by number first: the core decides to reuse it, create it, or send it to review.

## Attach the original
The original PDF or image is attached to the bill; the core then deletes its own copy.

## Report
What happened goes back to the core, then the next invoice.

## Failures
Facts about a failed step (HTTP status, QuickBooks error code). The core decides: retry later, stop, or open a review item.
